narrow: The asserted all-regime Kennedy--Balakrishnan--Robins--Wasserman rate is not proved on the exact singleton uniform-design class.  For \(S=\alpha+\beta<\gamma\), disjoint partition-local bumps at amplitude \(\delta=\ell^S\) have contrast H\"older scale \(\delta\ell^{-\gamma}=\ell^{S-\gamma}\), which diverges as \(\ell\downarrow0\); overlapping smooth frames do not satisfy the partition-local hypothesis of RobinsTchetgenLiVanderVaart2009, Theorem 2.1; and filling the transition holes of the published support-modified construction contributes an uncancelled term of order \(nh^d\delta^2\), which diverges at the proposed nuisance rate below the elbow.  Under exactly the same model assumptions, the established oracle converse and first-order data-only estimator prove the stated bracket in every regime and a matching pure-power rate when \(S\ge\gamma\).  This narrows only the conclusion, not the model class.
